caseStudies.title: Case Studies
caseStudies.subtitle: Real problems, measurable results. Here's how we've helped companies scale their backend infrastructure.

fintechApiRebuild.title: API Infrastructure Rebuild
fintechApiRebuild.problem: A Series B fintech company was experiencing API latency issues during peak trading hours. Their monolithic architecture couldn't handle the growing user base, resulting in failed transactions and customer complaints.

healthcareDataPlatform.title: HIPAA-Compliant Data Platform
healthcareDataPlatform.problem: A healthcare platform needed to process and store sensitive patient data while maintaining HIPAA compliance. Their existing infrastructure lacked proper encryption, audit trails, and access controls.

ecommerceScale.title: Infrastructure Cost Optimization
ecommerceScale.problem: An e-commerce scale-up was spending heavily on cloud infrastructure with inefficient resource utilization. Their architecture wasn't optimized for their traffic patterns, leading to over-provisioning.

saasMigration.title: Legacy System Migration
saasMigration.problem: A mature SaaS company was running on aging infrastructure with a monolithic application. Deployment cycles were slow, and the system was difficult to maintain and scale.

realtimeAnalytics.title: Real-time Analytics Pipeline
realtimeAnalytics.problem: An AdTech company needed to process millions of events per second for real-time bidding decisions. Their batch processing system couldn't meet the latency requirements.

contact.faq1Content: Most engagements start with a discovery phase where we understand your current state and constraints. From there, we scope specific deliverables with clear timelines. Engagements typically range from focused 4-week sprints to multi-month partnerships.

measuresItems: ARIA labels and roles for interactive components
Keyboard navigation support with visible focus indicators
Skip navigation link to main content
Color contrast ratios meeting WCAG AA standards
Responsive design for all screen sizes
Reduced motion support for users who prefer it
Focus trap management in modal dialogs
Form validation with accessible error messages
Structured headings for screen reader navigation

services.q: What backend services do you offer?
services.a: We offer six specialized backend engineering services: API Architecture, Database Design, Cloud Infrastructure, System Integration, Performance Optimization, and Security Audits. Each engagement is tailored to your specific needs. Our approach emphasizes documentation, observability, and knowledge transfer to your team.

process.q: How does your engagement process work?
process.a: Our process has four phases: Discovery (understanding your constraints and objectives), Architecture (designing systems for growth), Build (production-ready code with testing and monitoring), and Support (continuous monitoring and optimization). We document every decision and never over-engineer.

contact.q: How can I get in touch?
contact.a: You can reach us through our contact page, email hello@innovexle.com, or call +92 318 6618194. We have offices in Lahore (Punjab, Pakistan), London (UK), and USA. We typically respond within one business day. For urgent backend engineering challenges, we recommend filling out the contact form with your project details so we can provide a focused response.

careers.q: Are you hiring? What roles are open?
careers.a: Yes! We're always looking for skilled backend engineers who care about reliability and scale. Our careers page lists all open positions with department, location, and experience level filters. We're a remote-first consultancy, so most roles offer flexible location.

pricing.q: How do you price your services?
pricing.a: Our pricing depends on project scope, timeline, and complexity. We don't publish fixed rates because every engagement is different. The best way to get a tailored proposal is to share your requirements through our contact form. We're transparent about costs and will discuss options before any commitment.

technologies.q: What technologies do you work with?
technologies.a: We work with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud), databases (PostgreSQL, Redis), orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and modern backend stacks. We're technology-agnostic when it makes sense—we choose the right tools for your constraints, not the trend of the month.

remote.q: Do you work remotely or on-site?
remote.a: We're a remote-first consultancy. Most of our work is done async with clear communication rhythms. We can do on-site workshops or discovery sessions when valuable. Our clients span multiple regions, and we've built our processes to support distributed collaboration.

engagement.q: What does a typical engagement look like?
engagement.a: Engagements vary from short architecture reviews to multi-month build projects. We start with a discovery call to understand your needs, then propose a tailored scope. We work in iterations, with regular demos and feedback. Every engagement includes documentation and knowledge transfer so your team can own the system.
